title: Must have Super Human Strength
text:
Must have Super Human Strength. This "gizmo" is useless for me. I am a huge user of the potato masher, I love lumps in my potatoes. However, my husband hates lumpy potatoes so I am always using the hand mixer to whip up the potatoes. I thought this kitchen gizmo spring loaded potato masher and ricer would be a perfect combination. However, I do not have super human strength as my super power so it was impossible to actually mash potatoes using this masher. Even when I could get the potatoes through the ricer, the potatoes would stick in the masher above the ricer and it was hard to get it out.

It does seem like this is well made and would last a long time. But unless I turn into the Hulk, I will not be using it.

I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest review.

description: Do you hate lumpy mashed potatoes? Yes, of course, everybody does!  Just try
new uniquely designed masher / ricer. With two spring-loaded stainless steel plates, your potatoes will be smoother and creamier than you've ever had.

The bottom plate is designed like a traditional masher while the top has a fine grid ricer. Just push down to press the two plates together, the bottom does the heavy lifting, and the top does the rest of the work. Just lift and the spring will separate the plates, ready for the next press.

The handle is made from cushioned rubber ensure a comfortable grip. Its ergonomic design will not hurt your hands even after mashing the stubbornest root vegetable. With a large opening on top so you can hang it easily for storage.
Everything is made from top-quality materials from the stainless steel plates to the rubberized handle. The potato masher is LFGB Approved, PBA free and Dishwasher Safe.
